title: 지하철에서 자리 양보하기: "여기 앉으세요"
objective: Offer a seat and give a short reason with -는데/-(으)ㄴ데.
summary: Offer your seat on the subway and give a reason with -는데.
setting: A crowded subway car in the afternoon. Minjun, a university student, is sitting down.

task.title: Use the subway expressions
task.line: Use the dialogue and the word list to choose, complete, order, or write each answer.

words.meaning: gives a reason or background before a request or suggestion. Verbs and 있다/없다: -는데 (내리는데). Adjectives: -은데 after a consonant (많은데), -ㄴ데 after a vowel (피곤한데).
words.exampleMeaning: It's crowded, so shall we take the next train?

words.meaning: to give up (a seat) for someone
words.exampleMeaning: I gave up my seat for a pregnant woman.
It was crowded, so I stood the whole time.

words.meaning: to get off (a train or bus)
words.exampleMeaning: Are you getting off at the next station?

words.meaning: to hold or carry something for someone
words.exampleMeaning: Sorry, could you please hold my bags?

dialogue.meaning: Oh, that's okay. I'm getting off soon.
I'm getting off soon too, so please sit down and relax.

dialogue.korean: 괜찮아요. 아까부터 계속 앉아 있었는데 이제 좀 서 있고 싶어요.
dialogue.meaning: I'm fine. I've been sitting for a long time, so now I want to stand for a bit.
Then thank you. I'll sit down.

exercises: Complete each sentence with -는데 or -(으)ㄴ데: ① 지하철이 (복잡하다) ____ 조금 기다릴까요? ② 할아버지가 (서 계시다) ____ 자리를 양보할까요? ③ 열차가 (오다) ____ 빨리 가요!
Put the words in order to make one sentence: 좀 / 다리가 / 앉아도 돼요? / 아픈데
Answer in English using the dialogue: ① Why does Minjun say he is fine with standing? ② What does the grandmother do in the end?
Write in Korean: You are sitting on the subway. A woman standing in front of you has a heavy bag. Tell her that the bag looks heavy, so you will hold it for her. Use -는데/-(으)ㄴ데 and 들어 주다.
answers: ① 복잡한데 ② 서 계시는데 ③ 오는데
다리가 아픈데 좀 앉아도 돼요? (다리가 좀 아픈데 앉아도 돼요?)
① He has been sitting for a long time, so now he wants to stand for a while. ② She thanks him and sits down.
가방이 무거워 보이는데 제가 들어 드릴게요. (가방이 무거운 것 같은데 제가 들어 드릴게요.)
